Beach Therapy – Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Inlet Beach

Welcome to Beach Therapy, a luxury 30A vacation home just steps from the Gulf of Mexico and minutes from Rosemary Beach. With 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and space for up to 14 guests, this designer retreat is ideal for families, multi-family groups, and friends seeking an upscale coastal getaway.

A Home Designed for Relaxation & Comfort
Spread across four levels with elevator access, Beach Therapy offers both space and privacy. Two king master suites feature spa-style bathrooms with soaking tubs and marble showers. A custom-built bunk room sleeps up to eight and includes individual built-in TVs for each bed. All bedrooms feature blackout drapes, Euro-plush mattresses, and smart TVs.

Gulf Views & Prime Inlet Beach Location
Enjoy sweeping Gulf views from nearly every level of the home. You're just a short walk from the community pool and private beach access, with Inlet Beach's peaceful charm and close proximity to Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach—all just minutes away.

Entertaining Made Easy
The gourmet kitchen features Thermador appliances, double ovens, a 6-burner stove, wine fridge, and spacious island seating. Dine indoors or outside, then unwind in the fourth-floor den equipped with a smart TV, game table, and wet bar. The ground-level portico offers a grill, ping-pong table, and convenient half bath.

Outdoor Living on 30A
Enjoy Gulf breezes from three spacious balconies—perfect for morning coffee, afternoon relaxation, or sunset cocktails. Seasonal bikes are included for exploring the best of 30A.

Amenities You'll Love
Private beach access just steps away
Elevator to all levels
Outdoor entertaining area with grill and ping-pong table
High-speed Wi-Fi and streaming TVs throughout
6 adult bikes (seasonal)
Full laundry room and family-friendly floorplan
Whether you're searching for a luxury 30A beach house, a tranquil Inlet Beach retreat, or the perfect multi-family vacation home, Beach Therapy delivers an unforgettable Gulf Coast escape.

Community Amenities
Inlet Beach offers a true “local” feel from the moment you arrive. Enjoy the largest public beach access in South Walton, fish from the Gulf, explore new dining and shopping options, or bike to Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach for world-class shopping and dining.

Parking
This home includes three designated parking spaces total.
The HOA strictly enforces parking rules—violations may result in towing at the guest's expense.
Overflow parking is not available anywhere nearby.

Reservation & Booking Policies
The cancelation policy and terms in the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement override those from third-party booking sites (VRBO, HomeAway, VacationRentals.com).
We cannot reimburse third-party booking service fees.
We do not offer a 100% refund once a booking is processed. A 5% cancelation fee applies to all cancelations.
No Smoking
No Pets Allowed (except certified service animals with advance notice and documentation)
Published rates do not include taxes and fees
50% deposit due at booking
Remaining balance due 60 days prior to arrival
Except for a 5% cancelation fee, the initial 50% deposit is fully refundable when cancelation is received more than 60 days prior to arrival
Optional travel insurance available (must be purchased before final payment or at time of full payment)
Exterior security camera present at parking area
Check-in: 4:00 PM (CST) | Check-out: 10:00 AM (CST)
Primary renter must be 25+ and remain on the premises for the entire stay
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on the beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
